set.body: Discovered while fixing bd-01M43S7GV3M4E6AC1W35DPF17C. The box-quadrature fix bounds Quadrature.boxOffsets only. Regressor.hrfFineColumns in modules/hrf/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/fmri/hrf/regressor/Regressor.scala still computes floor(span / dt).toInt + 1 before Array.ofDim. EventTerm.convolveShared prepares this grid through Regressor.prepareConvolution, whose current checks admit any finite positive precision. Audit the sampled convolution grid and drive allocation counts together, add documented work budgets before Int conversion/allocation, and preserve typed errors at preparation/design entry points. Add bounded threshold and overflow regressions on JVM+JS and mutation evidence. This is a source-inspection finding; no deliberately enormous allocation was executed. Keep this separate from the completed box-integral work budget and from orthogonalization/performance nits.
set.title: Bound sampled convolution grids before Int conversion and allocation
